headline: Runa Khan, Tommy Koh and Bo Kyi Named 2026 Ramon Magsaysay Awardees
seoTitle: 2026 Ramon Magsaysay Awardees Announced | FMB News
seoDescription: The Ramon Magsaysay Award Foundation named Runa Khan, Tommy Koh and Bo Kyi as the 2026 recipients of Asia's premier leadership award.
keywords: Runa Khan Tommy Koh Bo Kyi
deck: The awardees were recognized for humanitarian service, diplomacy and the defense of political prisoners and human dignity.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Ramon Magsaysay Award Foundation announced Runa Khan of Bangladesh, Tommy Koh of Singapore and Bo Kyi of Myanmar as its 2026 awardees.

sections.heading: Why they were recognized
paragraphs: Khan was honored for building humanitarian services for remote communities in Bangladesh. Koh was recognized for decades of diplomacy, international law and public service. Bo Kyi was honored for documenting abuses and defending political prisoners and human dignity in Myanmar.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Established in 1957, the Ramon Magsaysay Award recognizes transformative leadership and public service in Asia.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: The 2026 recipients represent three different forms of public leadership: direct humanitarian service, institution-building through diplomacy, and sustained human-rights advocacy.
